id.description: The Id of the registered card in the Tyro Connect system.

paymentId.description: Payment Identifier generated from the payment source. It refers to the `transaction.receipt` (from Tyro eCommerce APIs) or otherwise referred to as the RRN.

memberId.description: The identifier of the member who is associated with this card.

preAccumulatedReward.description: The pre-accumulated reward amount on the card at the time of registration. If you have opted to represent rewards in AUD, then this value is in cents.
